Biography
x: Klaus Mueller is Professor of Computer Science at Stony Brook University and Senior Scientist at Brookhaven National Laboratory. He directs the Visual Analytics and Imaging (VAI) Lab. His work lies at the intersection of visualization, visual analytics, explainable and human-centered AI, and medical imaging, with applications in public health, science, and healthcare. He received his Ph.D. in Computer and Information Science from The Ohio State University in 1998 and joined Stony Brook in 1999. He is an IEEE Fellow (class of 2024), a member of the National Academy of Inventors, and a recipient of the NSF CAREER award.
